messages:
paul: Quick check — ran Aster-13B int6 vs int8 on the GTN chat sample (3k queries). Putting numbers here, looking for routing recs to hit product cost targets and keep hallucination risk low.

amira: can you drop the unit-econ breakdown + latency?

paul: sure, pasted the CSV we used:
```
mode,avg_latency_ms,avg_tokens,avg_cost_per_resp
int8,220,420,$0.00120
int6,180,420,$0.00065
hybrid(int6->int8 on fail),200,420,$0.00085
```

devon: what about quality deltas? any concrete metric diffs?

paul: short summary: int6 shows small degradation on long-form QA/coherence. Rouge-L delta -0.9, hallucination rate +1.8% on our knowledge prompts. For short chit-chat (<200 tokens) metrics are within noise.

luis: infra note: int6 packing improved throughput ~1.9x per GPU and memory footprint down ~30%. Good for Dedicated mixes.

amira: product constraint: GTN will accept up to +1% hallucination delta. int6 is slightly over. Also latency budget is 250ms.

paul: options:
- full int8 (safe on quality, higher cost)
- default int6 with fallback to int8 for flagged prompts (needs confidence signal / rerank)
- traffic split (e.g., 70/30) and observe

devon: hybrid is attractive but watch RTT. If we do first-pass int6 then rerun int8 on fallback, extra tail latency could hit budget. What's fallback rate?

paul: measured p_fallback ≈ 12% on our slice. Estimated avg latency ≈ 0.88*180 + 0.12*220 ≈ 186ms. Cost estimate for hybrid ≈ $0.00076/resp. So stays under latency budget and cost is ~37% lower than full int8.

amira: product: if hybrid reduces hallucination to <+1% we can accept. Otherwise prefer traffic-split that guarantees UX.

paul: quick proposal: start with 60% int6 / 40% int8 routing for GTN. Instrument the hallucination sentinel and a small A/B for user-facing metrics. Contingency: if hallucination delta >1% on rolling 48h slice, revert to 50/50 or full int8.

luis: I'll stand up dashboards: hallucination rate, Rouge-L slice, avg latency, token burn, and per-route cost. Also create an alert at +0.8% delta to give early warning.

amira: will brief GTN and growth — they prefer deterministic flag over hybrid complexity unless hybrid clearly wins cost with equal quality.

paul: action items:
- paul: push routing flags + run 2-week experiment (instrumented)
- luis: dashboards + alert
- devon: add telemetry for confidence signal if we want hybrid later
- amira: product comms and acceptance criteria

deploy-bot: Canary created: rf/aster13b-int6=0.6 rf/aster13b-int8=0.4 — scheduled 03:00 UTC.

luis: provisioning + dashboard links will be posted here once ready.

amira: thanks everyone — I'll sync with GTN PM at 11:30. :thumbsup:
